x-m-h1-07.title: Ngaba umgca uya kuchukumisa isangqa? Xa ulwazi luvezwa isiqwenga esinye ngexesha
x-m-h1-07.goal: Xela indawo yomgca nesangqa ngokuxhomekeke kwixabiso lengxelo engatshintshiyo k, uhlaziye isigwebo sakho ngolwazi olutsha, uze unciphise uluhlu luka-k apho bechukumisana khona.
x-m-h1-07.material: Kukho isangqa x²+y²=25 (isazulu kwimvelaphi, irediyasi 5) nomgca y=x+k. Tshintsha ixabiso lika-k ujonge inani lamachaphaza apho umgca nesangqa zidibana khona.
x-m-h1-07.prereq.1: Ubudlelwane phakathi kwenani lezisombululo xa usombulula umgca nesangqa kunye nenani lamachaphaza okudibana
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.prompt: Ixesha ngalinye xa ixabiso lika-k livezwa, xela uze ukhethe inani lamachaphaza okudibana okanye ixabiso lokuchukumisa.
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.hint.0: Unokuhlola inani lamachaphaza okudibana ngezisombululo zekhweshini oyifumanayo ngokusombulula iikhweshini zomgca nesangqa kunye.
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.hint.1: Bhala nendlela yokuthelekisa umgama ukusuka kwimvelaphi ukuya kumgca nobungakanani berediyasi.
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.st.0.info: Xa k=1, umgca yi-y=x+1. (Indawo yokunqumla i-y u-1 incinci kunerediyasi 5.)
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.st.0.after: x²+(x+1)²=25 yenza lula ibe yi-x²+x−12=0, ngoko x=−4, 3, kwaye amachaphaza okudibana yi-(−4, −3), (3, 4), ama-2 zonke. Umgca odlula kwichaphaza elingaphakathi kwesangqa (kufuphi nemvelaphi) uhlala udibana nesangqa kumachaphaza amabini.
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Oku kubonisa umbono wokuba umgca odlula ngaphakathi kwesangqa udibana nesangqa kabini.
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Esi sisigwebo sokuba umgca ungaphandle kwesangqa. Cinga ukuba imvelaphi ikude kangakanani nomgca.

x-m-h1-07.s.s1.st.1.info: k yanyuswa yaya ku-7. Umgca y=x+7 udibana ne-eksisi ye-y kwi-(0, 7), kwaye u-7 mkhulu kunerediyasi 5.
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.st.1.after: x²+(x+7)²=25 yenza lula ibe yi-x²+7x+12=0, ngoko x=−3, −4, kwaye amachaphaza okudibana yi-(−3, 4), (−4, 3), ama-2 zonke. Umgama ukusuka kwimvelaphi ukuya kumgca x−y+7=0 yi-7/√2 (7 phezu kwengcambu 2) ≈ 4.95, encinci kunerediyasi 5. Nokuba indawo yokunqumla i-y inkulu kune-5, umgca uyatyeka, ngoko ufikelela kwisangqa.
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ukuba ugweba ngendawo yokunqumla i-y kuphela, usenokuphosa isiphumo sethambeka lomgca. Cinga ngomgama ukusuka kwimvelaphi ukuya kumgca.
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ukuba iyachukumisa kufuneka ihlolwe ngomgama okanye ngediskriminanti. Unokuyibala.
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Oku kukucinga ngokungajongi kuphela indawo yokunqumla i-y kodwa nendlela umgca osondele ngayo kwisangqa. Sisigwebo esithandabuza ukuba umbono nokubala kunokwahluka.

x-m-h1-07.s.s1.st.2.ask: Liliphi ixabiso elibonakalisa ngokongeza lika-k elenza umgca uchukumise isangqa?

x-m-h1-07.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Thelekisa nolwazi lokuba sele kwakukho amachaphaza okudibana ama-2 kwa-k=7.
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ihambelana nolwazi lokuba ixabiso liphakathi kwe-7 ne-8. Kodwa bala ukuba umgama k/√2 phakathi kwemvelaphi nomgca kule k mkhulu okanye mncinci kune-5.
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Jonga kwakhona ulwazi lokuba k=7. U-6 mncinci kune-7.
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Esi sisigwebo esidibanisa iziqwenga zolwazi ezimbini kwaye sisebenzisa into yokuba ixabiso apho iyachukumisa lilele phakathi kwe-7 ne-8.
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.st.2.r.e: Kuvakala ngathi kuyenzeka, kodwa hlola ukuba umgama phakathi kwemvelaphi nomgca kwi-7.5 mkhulu okanye mncinci kune-5.
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.reflect: Ekuqaleni kwabonakala ukuba kwa-k=7, apho indawo yokunqumla i-y inkulu kunerediyasi, azizukudibana, kodwa ngokwenene zadibana kumachaphaza amabini. Luluphi ulwazi olukwenze wahlaziya uqikelelo lwakho? Yeyiphi imhlolo onokuyenza isiqhelo ukuze umbono ungakulahlekisi?
x-m-h1-07.s.s2.prompt: Kwa-k=7, chaza ukuba kutheni umbono wokuqala “indawo yokunqumla i-y inkulu kunerediyasi, ngoko azidibani” wawungalunganga, usebenzisa umgama phakathi kwemvelaphi nomgca okanye amakhowudinethi amachaphaza okudibana.

x-m-h1-01.title: Isisombululo sentsalela siphosakale phi?
x-m-h1-01.goal: Fumana umgca ophosakeleyo kwisisombululo esifumana intsalela, uyilungise, uze uhlole impendulo ephosakeleyo ngokuchasene nemeko yokuqala ukuqinisekisa impazamo.
x-m-h1-01.material: Esi sisisombululo sikaMinjae sokufumana ikhonkco a ukuze intsalela ibe ngu-6 xa ipolynomial f(x)=x³+ax²+x+2 ihlulwa nge-x+1. (x³ kuthetha u-x e-cube, kwaye ax² kuthetha a iphindaphindwe ngesikwere sika-x.)

x-m-h1-01.thinking.2: Faka impendulo ephosakeleyo kwimeko ubone ukuphikisana
x-m-h1-01.prereq.0: Uyazi unxulumano phakathi kwentsalela xa ipolynomial ihlulwa libinzana lomgca nexabiso lepolynomial.
x-m-h1-01.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umgca wokuqala kwisisombululo sikaMinjae ophosakeleyo.
x-m-h1-01.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala kwakhona i-x+1 ukuze umahluli abe nefom ye-x−(inani elithile).
x-m-h1-01.s.s1.hint.1: Thelekisa elo nani nexabiso olifake kwi-f.
x-m-h1-01.s.s1.line.0: Intsalela xa f(x)=x³+ax²+x+2 ihlulwa nge-x+1 ngu-6.
x-m-h1-01.s.s1.line.1: Ngethiyori yentsalela, intsalela xa kwahlulwa nge-x+1 yi-f(1).
x-m-h1-01.s.s1.explain: Umgca wesi-2 uphosakele. x+1 inokubhalwa njenge-x−(−1), ngoko intsalela yi-f(−1), hayi i-f(1). Imigca yesi-3 nesi-4 ilandela nje umgca wesi-2, ngoko ubalo olungaphakathi kuyo lulungile, kodwa iziphumo zayo ziphosakele.
x-m-h1-01.s.s2.prompt: Lungisa umgca ophosakeleyo ufumane ixabiso lika-a. Emva koko bhala nokuba intsalela yintoni xa ufaka u-a=2 kaMinjae kwi-f(x) uze wahlule nge-x+1, ukubonisa ukuba kutheni impendulo kaMinjae ingasebenzi.
x-m-h1-01.s.s2.hint.0: Kuqala bhala ixabiso lika-x eliyenza x+1=0.
x-m-h1-01.s.s2.hint.1: Faka u-a owafumana ngomgca olungisiweyo ne-a=2 kaMinjae kwi-f(x), uze uthelekise iintsalela.
x-m-h1-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingaba ubale i-f(−1) ngqo kwisisombululo esilungisiweyo?
x-m-h1-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingaba ubale intsalela xa a=2 waza wabonisa ukuba ayingu-6?
x-m-h1-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ingaba ungathi ukuhlola kuvumbulula njani impazamo kwisisombululo?
x-m-h1-01.s.s2.model.0: x+1=x−(−1), ngoko intsalela yi-f(−1). f(−1)=−1+a−1+2=a, kwaye oku ngu-6, ngoko a=6. Ukuba ndifaka u-a=2 kaMinjae, ngoko f(−1)=2, ngoko ayingu-6.
x-m-h1-01.s.s2.model.1: Xa kwahlulwa nge-x+1, kufuneka ndifake x=−1, ngoko f(−1)=a. Intsalela ngu-6, ngoko a=6. Hlola: ukuba a=2, ngoko f(−1)=−1+2−1+2=2, ngoko ayihambelani nemeko.
x-m-h1-01.s.s2.modelNote.1: Ukuhlola ngexabiso elichanekileyo (ukuba a=6, ngoko f(−1)=6) nayo yindlela elungileyo.

x-m-h1-02.s.s1.r.d: Inani lezisombululo ezipheleleyo nokuba umahluko weengcambu linani eliphelele kufuneka kuqwalaselwe ngokwahlukeneyo. Zama ukungalingani okunje nge-x²−3<0.
